ELWYNN SURVIVAL AND BASIN BATTLE - FOR WINDOWS PLAYERS
=====================================================

Two co-op games run by the same host on the "benilla" game client, which
uses the art and sound from your own copy of World of Warcraft 1.12.1:

- ELWYNN SURVIVAL (double-click "Play Elwynn Survival.bat"): a soulslike
  survival game in Elwynn Forest. Gather, build a camp, hold it against
  raids, go down below into the Deadmines, and fight other players in
  Siege (Arathi Basin) from the book at camp.
- BASIN BATTLE (double-click "Play Basin Battle.bat"): defend the Ancient in
  Arathi Basin against endless waves. Its own section is further down.

This download contains only the game client, a launcher and the two
add-ons. It contains no World of Warcraft files. You need your own WoW
1.12.1 install.


WHAT YOU NEED
-------------
1. A World of Warcraft 1.12.1 install: a folder with WoW.exe in it and a
   "Data" folder inside it (dbc.MPQ, model.MPQ, texture.MPQ...). Version
   1.12.1 specifically: newer WoW Classic installs will NOT work.
2. A graphics card with up-to-date drivers (DirectX 12 or Vulkan).
3. The address of the game from whoever is hosting, plus its password.


FIRST TIME
----------
1. Unzip this whole folder somewhere you like, e.g. Documents\Basin Battle.
   Keep all the files together.
2. Double-click "Play Elwynn Survival.bat" (or "Play Basin Battle.bat").
   Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click "More info", then
   "Run anyway". You only need to do this once.
3. A folder picker opens (look behind the console window if you don't see
   it). Choose your World of Warcraft 1.12.1 folder, the one with WoW.exe.
4. Type the address the host gave you and press Enter.
5. The game opens and the launcher window closes itself. On the login
   screen type ANY account name (it becomes your hero's name) and the
   host's password (default: hold).

Your folder and the address are saved in settings.txt: next time just
double-click the .bat and press Enter.


UPDATING TO A NEW ZIP
---------------------
Close the game, then unzip the new zip over your old folder (say yes to
replacing files). Your settings.txt, your mouse speed, key changes and
other settings are kept: the zip doesn't carry them.

Only ONE game window should be open. The game's window is titled
"benilla"; the black launcher window closes itself once the game starts.
If you're unsure, close every benilla window and start again from the
.bat.


ELWYNN SURVIVAL: CONTROLS
-------------------------
Press K in the game for the full list (click any key there to change it).

  W A S D           move (A and D step sideways)
  Mouse             look round; the hero turns with it
  Middle mouse      hold to look round without turning
  Left mouse        attack (Shift + left: heavy attack)
  Right mouse       guard; just as a blow lands: parry
  Right + left      shield bash / kick
  Mouse 4           tap: dodge roll; hold: sprint
  Shift             sprint (hold)
  Space             jump
  Tab               lock on to a foe; Tab again lets go
  Ctrl + Tab        next foe while locked on
  Q E 1 2 3         abilities (3 is the ultimate: hold it)
  Hold Q/E/1/2      the charged-up version (costs Valor; Ctrl + key too)
  F                 use what's in front of you; place, while building
  T / G             eat or use the quick item / pick the next one
  R                 sheathe or draw your weapon
  X                 walk / run          Num Lock   autorun
  V                 health bars over heads on / off
  B  bags   N  ability board   J  journal   H  build   C  character   M  map
  Z                 free the mouse to click things (Z again to fight)
  K                 the controls card: change keys, mouse speed, where
                    and how big your health bar is, floor markers on/off

- Mouse too fast or too slow? K, then the - and + by "Mouse speed". It's
  kept for next time (the game's own sensitivity slider stops at a speed
  most people find too fast, so use this one).
- "Use my own keys" on the K card plays with your own saved WoW key
  bindings instead; "Use the Elwynn keys" switches back.
- Blows cost stamina (the green bar under your health). Read a creature's
  wind-up and punish after its blow: a heavy attack doesn't stop a blow
  that's already coming.


SIEGE (IN ELWYNN SURVIVAL)
--------------------------
Open the book at camp and pick Siege to go to Arathi Basin. At the banner
join 1v1, 2v2, 1v1v1 or 1v1v1v1; it begins once the seats are full (or
".siege start"). Everyone starts fresh with two cards.

- Keep your Hearth standing: waves come in at your gate (marked red on the
  ground) and walk to it. Strike a creature hitting your Hearth and it
  turns on you once its blow is done.
- Gold: from your income (paid every wave), from creatures you fell and
  from the veins in the middle. Build defences (H), send creatures at a
  rival from the Mercenary Ledger (F at it; each send raises your income;
  only so many may go each wave), learn more cards at the Battle Trainer.
- Food and salves arrive with every wave (T eats).
- Ready early? F at your Hearth. When everyone is ready, the next wave
  comes in 5 seconds.


BASIN BATTLE: PLAYING
---------------------
- Your spells are on keys 1, 2, 3, 4, Q and E (A and D strafe): press them to cast at your
  target (or the nearest enemy). Right-click an enemy to auto-attack.
- Card picks offer a new class spell or an upgrade for one you have.
  Upgrades change how a spell plays, so read them!
- Some cards are talents: they come at full rank. Talents that teach a
  spell take one of your six spell keys; once all six are full you're only
  offered upgrades and passive talents.
- Drag a spell onto another key, empty or not (or Shift-click the spell,
  then the key), to move it there. To use
  other keys, rebind Action Button 1-6 in the game's Key Bindings menu.
- Mage and priest spells (and Aimed Shot) have cast times: stand still
  until the bar fills. Moving interrupts the cast.
- Enemies mark the ground before a big hit: step out of the marked spot.
  A line of marks: step aside. A ring of marks: get in close.
- The list on the right of the screen tells you what to do next.
- Press M for the map: it shows enemies, bosses, defences and your party
  live.
- Health bars float over your defences and party; press V to show the
  enemies' too. Defences wear down under attack: guard them, or rebuild
  them from the Shop.
- The damage meter on the right: Party shows everyone's damage this wave
  (and the base's defences and your soldiers'), You shows your own by spell (Reset starts it over). Click the open tab
  again to fold it.
- Stay near the Ancient: if it falls, the run is over.
- Chat commands: .start skips the countdown, .status shows the wave,
  .restart starts over, .bb auto makes your spells fire on their own.
- If you die you get back up at the Ancient after a few seconds.
- Gold buys defences and upgrades in the Shop (press B, or the button
  above your spell bar), from anywhere, even while you're dead.
- Enemies follow the roads and cross the river by the two bridges to the
  Blacksmith: hold a bridge to hold several lanes at once. You can build
  defences at each bridge too (tabs in the Shop).
- The panel on the right shows how many enemies come over each bridge.
  Click Hold to claim a bridge, Help! to call your friends.
- Every fifth wave a boss leads (its health bar shows under the wave tracker):
  at half health it calls its dead, at a quarter it rages.
- Plague Sappers (from wave 6) ignore you and run for the Ancient to blow
  up there: catch them on the way. Shrieking Heralds (from wave 8) drive
  every enemy near them on, harder and faster: kill them first.
- Hunter's Mark, Frost Nova, Charge and a priest's heals all steer the
  defences: read your spells to see how.
- Plague Butchers (rare, from wave 9) mark a cleave on the ground that
  takes 40% of your health, however tough you are: get out of it.
- Warriors are the tanks: the most health, plate, and 15% less damage taken.
  Armour matters for everyone.
- The Shop's Hero tab sells items: rings, necklaces, trinkets and cloaks that
  change how you play. Four on offer, new ones every wave. A bought one goes
  straight on if its slot is free; otherwise it's in your bags to drag on.
- Elites come with a twist in their name: Vampiric, Frenzied, Swift or Thorned
  (Thorned hurts whoever hits it up close: fight it from range).
- Stand near a friend for Shoulder to Shoulder: 10% more damage, 10% less taken.
- Survive wave 20 (the Archlich) to win the run. The waves go on after.



TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------
"benilla: no WoW install found"
    The folder you picked isn't a 1.12.1 install. Delete settings.txt and
    pick the folder that has WoW.exe and Data\dbc.MPQ in it.

"Unable to connect" on the login screen
    - Check the address with the host.
    - The host must have the game running (scripts/host.sh).
    - Over the internet, the host's router must forward ports 3724, 8085 and
      8086 to their computer.

The game window is black or closes right away
    Update your graphics drivers from NVIDIA, AMD or Intel and try again.

Anti-virus removed benilla.exe
    It's flagged because it's new and unsigned. Restore it from your
    anti-virus quarantine, or ask the host for a fresh copy.

No mouse cursor after logging out
    The cursor comes back as you leave the world. If it doesn't (an old
    benilla.exe), Alt+Tab out of the game and back in.

The game's sound went off
    Ctrl+S toggles the sound in WoW. Elwynn Survival keeps Ctrl+S moving
    you back, but outside it (or with an old add-on) press Ctrl+S again.

Keys acting strangely after an update
    Press K and click "Elwynn keys again". A new version may put everyone
    back on the Elwynn keys once; you'll see a line in the chat saying so.
